title: Implement pod double buffer profile snapshot handoff
description:
Create ONLY Source/Profiles/ProfileSnapshot.h and Source/Profiles/ProfileSnapshot.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h for ProfileDocument and kMacroNames (task i.1).
- Source/Profiles/ProfileManager.h for the catalog access used by the publishing side (task i.2).
- Source/Parameters/MacroEngine.h for the macro destination table shape the audio thread consumes (task i.4).
Do NOT modify any of those files. Never modify anything under JUCE/.

Implement the binding cross-thread contract exactly:
1. Define a POD struct ProfileSnapshotData containing only trivially copyable scalars and fixed-size arrays: base parameter values (fixed-size float array sized by a compile-time constant kMaxSnapshotParameters), macro destination tables (kMacroCount == 8 by kMaxDestinationsPerMacro entries of {int destinationIndex; float deltaMin; float deltaMax; float curve;}), scene numeric targets (4 scenes by 8 macro targets plus mixTarget, routingTarget as int, holdBehaviour as int). static_assert(std::is_trivially_copyable_v<ProfileSnapshotData>) and static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<ProfileSnapshotData>).
2. NO juce::String, no std::string, no pointer to heap data, no tags, no filenames, and no profile_name inside ProfileSnapshotData. Strings and metadata must never enter the snapshot; add a static_assert-backed comment stating this.
3. ProfileSnapshotHandoff owns exactly TWO preallocated ProfileSnapshotData instances as a member array (no heap allocation after construction), plus std::atomic<int> activeIndex and std::atomic<std::uint32_t> generation.
4. publish(const ProfileSnapshotData&) is message-thread only: it writes into the inactive slot, then stores the new activeIndex with std::memory_order_release, then increments generation with std::memory_order_release.
5. acquire() is audio-thread safe: it loads generation with std::memory_order_acquire, loads activeIndex with std::memory_order_acquire, and returns a const reference to the active slot. It performs no allocation, no locking, no destruction of heap-owned objects, and no unbounded loops.
6. std::atomic<std::shared_ptr> is forbidden anywhere in this file. No mutex, no juce::CriticalSection, no juce::SpinLock.
7. Provide buildSnapshot(const ProfileDocument&, const juce::StringArray& parameterIds, ProfileSnapshotData& out) as a message-thread helper that fills the POD from the validated document, dropping anything that does not fit the fixed capacities rather than resizing.

No artist or song name may appear in any comment, string, or identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Source/Profiles/ProfileSnapshot.h and Source/Profiles/ProfileSnapshot.cpp exist and declare ProfileSnapshotData, ProfileSnapshotHandoff, publish, acquire, and buildSnapshot
ProfileSnapshotHandoff holds exactly two preallocated ProfileSnapshotData slots and allocates no memory outside its constructor
publish uses std::memory_order_release for activeIndex and generation, and acquire uses std::memory_order_acquire for both
Neither file contains std::atomic<std::shared_ptr>, std::mutex, juce::CriticalSection, juce::SpinLock, juce::String members inside ProfileSnapshotData, or std::string
No artist or song name appears in either file
No file outside this task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h, Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.cpp, Source/Profiles/ProfileManager.h, or Source/Profiles/ProfileManager.cpp
use any lock, mutex, juce::CriticalSection, or juce::SpinLock
store strings, tags, or filenames in the snapshot
allocate or free memory in publish or acquire
include artist or song names in comments, strings, or identifiers

allowed: choose concrete values for kMaxSnapshotParameters and kMaxDestinationsPerMacro
choose field ordering inside the POD
add local static helpers inside ProfileSnapshot.cpp
forbidden: introduce a lock-free queue library or juce::AbstractFifo for this handoff
change the schema or the manager
add a third snapshot slot or dynamic slot count
make the audio thread parse or validate profiles
